name: Agricultural Bank of China Limited
summary: Agricultural Bank of China Limited offers a comprehensive array of banking solutions, catering to both corporate and individual clients. Its operations are organized into three primary divisions: Corporate Banking, Personal Banking, and Treasury Operations. The bank facilitates a wide spectrum of deposit types, including demand accounts, personal call accounts, various foreign currency time and call deposits, certificates of deposit, savings accounts, agreed-term deposits, and negotiated deposits. Its lending portfolio is equally diverse, encompassing home loans, consumer credit, business financing, fixed asset loans, working capital facilities, real estate lending, and entrusted syndicated loans. Additionally, it supports trade finance, issues guarantees and commitments, and provides loans linked to export rebates accounts. Beyond its core banking activities, the institution delivers an extensive range of supplementary services, including credit and debit cards, payment and settlement processing, bespoke private banking, cash management, investment banking, custodial services, and wealth management. Agricultural Bank of China Limited was established in 1951 and is headquartered in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
